Dry Van · Reefer · Open Deck · Independent Contractor / Team Driver

OTR 1099 Driver: Dry Van, Reefer, Open Deck & Team, Up to $1 CPM

$1,000 sign-on bonus, new 2025–2026 equipment and a 3,500-mile weekly minimum. Choose cents per mile or 30% of gross.

Apply for this job 2 minutes · No resume needed
PayUp to $1.00 CPM team
Home time3+ weeks out, 1 day off per week on the road
Truck2025–2026 Volvo & Freightliner
Experience12 months OTR

Pay rates

Dry VanUp to 75 CPM or 30% of gross
ReeferUp to 78 CPM or 30% of gross
Open DeckUp to 80 CPM or 30% of gross
Team Dry VanUp to $1.00 CPM or 30% of gross

Pay

  • $1,000 sign-on bonus
  • 3,500+ miles per week minimum
  • Weekly pay: statement Tuesday, direct deposit Thursday
  • Cash advance up to $200
  • Detention $20/hr after 3 hours, layover from day 2

Home time

  • Minimum 3 weeks out (4 preferred)
  • 1 day off earned per week on the road
  • 45+ days out: up to $150 home-time reimbursement
  • Keep the truck up to 5 days at home

Truck

  • 2025–2026 Volvo & Freightliner and trailers
  • Fridge, microwave, inverter, APU
  • Forward-facing camera, governed 73 mph
  • Swift ELD, Comdata fuel card with discount

Requirements

  • Valid CDL (no non-domicile / limited-term)
  • 12+ months OTR, willing to run all 48
  • Max 2 violations in 12 months, max 1 accident in 12 months
  • No felonies, DUI or SAP; no failed tests in 3 years

Costs to know

  • Escrow $1,250 (van) / $1,500 (open deck)
  • Occupational insurance $179/month

Pay, routes, equipment and policies are subject to confirmation with the carrier and your recruiter. Average pay is an average, not a guarantee.
